name: save-boot-7-still-cloud-md1-2
description: #99 attempt 2 (diagnostic): boot from the generated save harness/saves/disc1-cloud-md1-2.json (md1_2, field ID 0x76 per ff7-flat-wiki Field_ID; triangle 0, x 0x7FFF so the game places the player at the triangle's centroid, as #38 did; progress 6 as at md1stin; party [0, 255, 255]: Cloud alone, as attempt 1), loaded as save-boot-1-load does. Then 90 frames with no input: s0..s2 are the signs of the PosX change of field models 0-2, i.e. which models move on their own (NPCs, followers), to tell them from the player in the walk scenario for the same save. Only small integers leave.
